items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I heard about Buddy Petty's funeral. Yeah. I think they had a big one.

ctx.x: You know what he did with his money?

He had to use a bugle with crape on it that instant. That's what he had to represent his trumpet or bugle. Yeah. That was, where was that? Did he have a band when he was buried? Do you remember? Yeah. Three bands. Three bands. Three bands. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I heard about Buddy Petty's funeral. Yeah. I think they had a big one. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. They had a band when he was buried. They had a band when he was buried.
